family.description: This entry is of proteins of approximately 600 residues in length containing alternating regions of conservation and low complexity. The Arabidopsis protein is a replisome factor found to bind with the mini-chromosome maintenance, MCM-binding, complex and is crucial for efficient DNA replication. The family now spans the full-length proteins.
family.name: Mini-chromosome maintenance replisome factor
